artworks.title: The Hat Pin (Le chapeau épingle)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two women, with a focus on the upper half of their bodies. The woman on the left is sitting and facing slightly towards the viewer, while the other woman is positioned with her back towards the viewer, seemingly adjusting the first woman's hat. The facial features of the woman on the left are portrayed with soft lines, with her eyes partially closed, and her hair neatly styled under the hat. The hat is adorned with detailed embellishments. Both women are dressed in flowing garments, depicted with textured and dynamic lines. The background is minimally detailed with light sketching, and the artwork is presented in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Children Playing Ball (Enfants jouant a la balle)
artworks.description: Four women shown from the waist up to about mid-thigh, engaged in an outdoor activity. Two women in the front are bending over, possibly picking something from the ground, while the two behind them are in mid-movement. The woman on the left has her hair tied back and wears a patterned garment, while the woman beside her has auburn hair in a loose bun and wears a rich red dress with puffed sleeves. Behind them, a woman lifting a bundle on her shoulder wears a dress with wide sleeves and long, dark hair cascading, and another woman holding a similar bundle is in motion. The women's clothing is voluminous and indicative of a historical or pastoral style. The setting is an open field with patches of grass, under a soft blue and white sky, creating a peaceful outdoor scene.

artworks.title: Study for a Bather (Etude pour une baigneuse)
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a nude female figure. She is positioned slightly turned, facing forward, with her head tilted gently to the side. Her facial features are delicately drawn, with softly rounded eyes and a calm expression, framed by long hair that falls loosely around her shoulders. The sketch highlights her bare upper torso with subtle, expressive lines. There is no visible clothing, jewelry, or objects she holds, and the background appears to be a simple, textured surface without any particular detail, drawing focus to the figure itself.

artworks.title: Woman Reclining (Femme couchee)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in a reclining position. The person's body is fully visible, with their head resting on their left arm, which is bent at the elbow, and their right hand resting on their thigh. The individual is laying on their side with their legs slightly bent. They have short hair, styled close to the scalp, and their facial features include closed eyes and a relaxed expression. The drawing emphasizes natural, soft lines, and the person appears to be unclothed. The background includes lightly indicated textures resembling a grassy or textured surface, and the person is lying on a lightly sketched surface resembling bedding. There are no additional clothing, jewelry, or objects present in the image.

artworks.title: Female Nude Reclining (Femme nue couchee)
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their side, resting on a cushioned surface. The individual is reclined with their head supported by their hand placed under a pillow. The person's facial features include closed eyes, a serene expression, and a softly curved mouth. They have short hair and wear minimal clothing, possibly a draped cloth around the lower body. The background has simple linear strokes suggesting bedding or fabric.

artworks.title: Pierre Renoir
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a child's head and shoulders. The child is facing slightly to the side with a serene expression. They have short hair covered by a large hat made of soft fabric. The child wears a simple garment, possibly a blouse, against a light-colored background. No jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Richard Wagner
artworks.description: This is a portrait drawing depicting a person's head and shoulders. The individual is facing slightly to one side with closed or downcast eyes, focusing on the mouth and eyes. The person has short to medium-length hair and wears a high-collared garment, possibly a coat or jacket. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image. The background is textured with broad, dark strokes.

artworks.title: La Guerre (The War)
artworks.medium: photomechanical relief print on red coated wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rider on a galloping horse above a chaotic background. The drawing is created with bold, dark lines on an orange background. The rider is depicted with a flowing garment, holding a sword and a branch. The horse is captured mid-stride. Beneath the horse, there are reclining figures in various poses. Intricate line work creates textures and shapes, suggesting urgency and drama. The scene evokes a vivid and symbolic narrative tension.

artworks.title: Landscape with a House (Paysage avec maison)
artworks.description: The image shows a serene landscape with two tree trunks at the forefront, surrounded by green brushstrokes. Further back is a small building partially hidden by foliage. Beyond that, there is a row of yellow trees against a pale backdrop. The horizon is at the midline with pink landmass in the distance. The sky above is light blue with a dappled texture. The color palette is pastel with soft greens, pinks, and yellows. The brushwork is delicate and impressionistic, emphasizing light and color over detail.

artworks.title: Boats at Flushing (Bateaux à Flessingue)
artworks.description: The image displays a harbor scene viewed from a dock or pier, with boats moored close by and distant ships and buildings visible. The boats exhibit detailed rigging and sails styled with dot-like brushstrokes. The color palette includes blues, yellows, and earth tones creating a serene atmosphere. The sky shows pale yellow and blue tones.

artworks.title: The Buoy (La bouée)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 40.1 x 32.4 cm (15 13/16 x 12 3/4 in.)

artworks.title: At Flushing (A Flessingue)
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with architectural elements like docks and boats in the background. Tree branches on the left are depicted with dotted brushstrokes, and buildings along the water's edge are textured. The color palette includes greens, blues, oranges, and browns. Thin masts or flagpoles with small flags are visible in the distance, leading to the sky, which has a soft, diffused light.

artworks.title: St. Tropez: The Port (Saint-Tropez: Le port)
artworks.description: This image depicts a quay or harbor scene with buildings along the water. A church tower with a red dome and yellow facade stands out in the distance. Sailboats with white sails are near the viewer, reflecting on the water. The pointillist style is used, creating forms and textures with dots and dashes of color. The color palette includes pastel hues of yellow, blue, and red, with light clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Banks of the River (Les Bords de rivière)
artworks.description: Closest to us in this print, on the left, a person dressed in a light-colored tunic stands on the grassy bank accompanied by a group of geese, some walking on land and some wading into the water. Behind them, the water of the river is a mix of blues and greens. Two individuals are rowing a small boat on the water. On the opposite side of the river are a cluster of red-roofed houses along the riverbank. Above the horizon, the sky occupies the top third of the composition, colored in soft blues and punctuated by greyish-pink clouds.

artworks.title: Miss May Belfort in the Irish and American Bar, rue Royale (Miss Belfort Belfort au Irish and American Bar, Rue Royale)
artworks.description: The image displays a partial view of a person's upper body in profile, showing the head, shoulders, and upper chest area. The individual faces to the right with a slightly elevated chin, showcasing their profile. They have short, curly hair framing the face and wear an elaborate hat with feathers or decorative elements. The eyebrows are lightly arched, and the lips are slightly parted. The clothing features fluffy or furry textures, suggesting a coat or garment with a large collar. Surrounding the central figure are faint outlines of other figures, one wearing a top hat. The background is minimal with light sketch lines and empty space, emphasizing the main subject.

artworks.title: Wounded Eros (Eros vanné)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated at a bar or table. The figure on the left wears a hat and a fur-trimmed coat, partially facing right with a subtle smile. The person on the right wears a large decorative hat and a coat with a fur collar, sitting closely next to them. A bottle is placed on the table in front. A third smaller figure is sketched in the foreground, appearing abstract with minimal clothing. The background is minimal and sketchy, emphasizing the figures over the surroundings.

artworks.title: Mlle. Pois Vert
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait sketch of a person. The person is depicted in a side profile with their head slightly tilted downward. Their facial features are lightly drawn, with emphasis on the closed eyes, a slightly downturned mouth, and softly sketched eyebrows. The hairstyle is loosely indicated with gentle curls framing the face. The sketch suggests the person is wearing a piece of clothing depicted with minimal lines, and there is a dark, prominent choker around their neck. The background is a plain beige color. There are a few small marks or symbols drawn on the image.

artworks.title: Polaire
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's partial upper body view. Her head is tilted backward and her gaze is directed upward and away from the viewer. She has heavy-lidded eyes, pronounced lips, and a sharp nose. The woman has short hair, possibly cropped or styled voluminously. She is wearing a garment around her shoulders, possibly a shawl, and holding a fan in her left hand. The background has a soft, uneven texture blending the figure into the surroundings.

artworks.title: Mme. Réjane
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body in a three-quarter pose. Their face is oriented towards the viewer with distinct facial features, including pronounced eyes and lips. The individual wears a hat, a jacket with a collar, and a loosely tied scarf or cravat around their neck. Their hair is mostly hidden under the hat. The background is lightly sketched with vertical lines, emphasizing the person in the forefront. The drawing is done in pencil with soft shading and confident line work.

artworks.title: Les Vieilles Histoires (cover/frontispiece)
artworks.medium: lithograph touched with watercolor on wove paper (proof)
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking to the right. He is wearing a top hat, a blue coat and pants, and holding a chain that leads to a white bear with brown accents. There is a smaller figure in the background. The backdrop includes a bridge, a tree-like balloon, and a line of text on the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Les Vieilles Histoires (cover/frontispiece)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in olive green on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear being led on a chain by a figure clad in formal attire. The drawing captures a riverside scene, with a bridge crossing over the water in the background and the suggestion of urban life. The bear is positioned to the left, depicted with shaggy fur and a strapped muzzle, walking behind the figure dressed in a suit and top hat. The setting includes a clear pathway bordered by lamps. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of the work of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec. The image is filled with text, including the title “Les Vieilles Histoires” and credits to Jean Goudezki and Désiré Dihau.

artworks.title: Yahne in His Box (Yahne dans sa loge)
Cover, Yvette Guilbert
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a woman in a side profile position, from the torso up. Her facial features are lightly sketched, with a visible eye and slightly raised nose. Her hair is styled back, with texture suggesting curls or waves. She wears a garment with a puffed sleeve and a long glove. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain. The text surrounding the sketch provides names and attribution, with the artist's signature at the bottom.
